🤖 **HOUSE RULES — THELINESHIFT**
*The machine runs on discipline. So does this room.*

1. **🧾 RECEIPTS OR IT DIDN'T HAPPEN.** Every graded play posts publicly — wins AND losses. We never delete a loss. Anyone selling you perfection is lying to you.
2. **🔒 TIER INTEGRITY.** Paid picks stay in paid rooms. Leaking tier content to non-members = instant removal, no refund, no appeal.
3. **🛰️ SCANS 6X DAILY** — 12a / 4a / 8a / 12p / 4p / 8p ET. Want the heads-up? Grab the 🛰️ Scan Alerts role (pinned post in #💬general-chat). No @everyone spam, ever.
4. **🎯 THE FREE PICK IS THE TEASE.** One free play per scan in #🎯free-pick. The full card lives behind the tiers — don't beg for free looks in chat.
5. **💬 TALK SHOP, NOT TRASH.** Debate picks all day. No harassment, no spam, no shilling other services, no "DM me for picks" parasites — insta-ban.
6. **🐋 WHALE TALK IS SACRED.** Top tier gets the terminal: line moves, closing lines, the why. What's said there stays there.
7. **🔞 18+ ONLY.** Betting involves risk — never wager what you can't afford to lose. If it stops being fun, step away: 1-800-GAMBLER.
